caption: A quiet, rainy residential street lined with trees and apartment buildings, where parked cars glisten under the downpour, and a distant pedestrian crosses the reflective road. The scene depicts a rainy day on a quiet residential street lined with trees and apartment buildings. Several cars are parked along the sides of the road, their surfaces glistening with rain. A pedestrian with an umbrella crosses the street in the distance. The heavy rain creates a reflective surface on the asphalt, enhancing the somber atmosphere. The overall tone is calm and peaceful, despite the downpour. The "Rain Everyday" watermark is visible in the lower left corner.
